summary: Galadriel: a Rust detector, fusion and justification toolkit for signed consistency, with optional NCP sidecars, an MI companion and offline PID studies; release 0.9.0 is an unpublished candidate. AGENTS.md is the operating contract; this index restates its operational facts for tools.

entry_documents.role: generators, coupled release records and qualification procedures
complete applicable CI command set, with local-adapter.yml

delivery.merge: Work on a signed branch, open a pull request, wait for the three required checks, then squash-merge.
delivery.signing: signed commits are required on main
delivery.attribution: no AI attribution or co-author trailers

gates.when: last, after every other edit, with every change staged
gates.command: python3 -B -E -s -S scripts/release_audit.py generate && python3 -B -E -s -S scripts/release_audit.py verify

gates.when: a release record, task projection or convergence input changes
gates.command: python3 -B -E -s -S repo_work/build_task_dispositions.py verify && python3 -B -E -s -S repo_work/local_convergence.py schema --repo .

gates.when: agent-index.json or a path it names changes
Rust source changes; part of the CI set, not the complete mirror

frozen.reason: immutable 116-task projection, bound with task-closure-plan.json and task-dispositions.json by clm-018-assurance.json
license files preserved byte for byte

ecosystem.relation: observer and raw-advisory publisher pinned to the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate
advisory producer and the drone MGW study fixture
advisory evidence only; it never grants or widens authority
offline PID studies under the pid-rs 1.0 migration contract
